newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Fokker to close after supplier pulls out.
newsitem.headline: Fokker to close after supplier pulls out.

text.p: Court-appointed administrators are to wind up bankrupt Dutch aircraft maker Fokker NV after Northern Ireland based Short Brothers, part of Canada's Bombardier Group, said it would no longer supply aeroplane parts, Dutch ANP news agency said on Thursday.

Citing Fokker works council sources, ANP said administrators had broken off attempts to broker a Fokker rescue by South Korea's Samsung Aerospace after Shorts said it would no longer supply the wings for Fokker planes.
